First, I need to determine the speed of the train. The train covers 120 kilometers in 1.5 hours. To find the speed, I'll divide the distance by the time: 120 km divided by 1.5 hours equals 80 km/h.

Next, I'll calculate the distance the train travels in 4 hours at the same speed. I'll multiply the speed by the time: 80 km/h multiplied by 4 hours equals 320 km.
